body:
# Market brief — Friday 2026-11-20 7:30 ET

## Calendar — next 5 market days (chronological)
**Fri 2026-11-20**
- All session — Monthly OPEX (equity, ETF, index options; SPX AM/PM) — gamma pin / vol reset
- 10:00 ET — UMich Sentiment final Nov — consumer confidence (prelim 51.0)

**Mon 2026-11-23**
- no major prints

**Tue 2026-11-24**
- 10:00 ET — Conference Board Consumer Confidence Nov — spending signal

**Wed 2026-11-25**
- 08:30 ET — GDP 2nd estimate Q3 + PCE Oct + Durable Goods — growth vs inflation vs Fed
- 14:00 ET — Beige Book — regional Fed color

**Fri 2026-11-27** (early close 1pm ET; Thu Thanksgiving closed)
- no major prints

## Stock / catalysts — next 30 days
**Window end-Nov 2026** — ASTS — BlueBird 17-19 ship for Blue Origin launch early Q1 2027 — window — company update Nov 9/12
**End-2026** — ASTS — initial intermittent US service target — window — company
**Mid-Dec 2026** — TMC — NOAA final determination on USA-A certification (exploration + commercial recovery app) — window — TMC 8-K Nov 9 / Nov 3 letter
ASTS: no single-day dated events found in 30d.
TMC: no earnings/AGM in 30d (next ~Mar 2027).
No dated geo/policy meetings with critical minerals/spectrum on agenda in window.

## Insiders — recently reported (ASTS, TMC)
ASTS: Nov 19 Form 4 — CTO Huiwen Yao exercised 40,000 AST LLC Incentive Equity Options at $0.0641, acquiring 40,000 Class A shares (holding ~74,750 direct). Exercise, not open-market purchase. No open-market buys/sells or 10b5-1 in last 14d. Prior grants/tax withhold earlier.
TMC: no Form 4/144 in last 14d.

## Rates and bonds
10y ~5.04-5.07% (Nov 19), 2y ~4.76-4.80%, 10y-2y +27-28bp (not inverted). 5y TIPS real ~2.66%, 5y breakeven ~2.23%. 5y5y forward ~2.10-2.15%. Growth soft after retail/PCE path, inflation expectations anchored, Fed path data-dependent into Dec.

## USD/JPY
Spot ~158.8-159.7, overnight lower. Range-bound near recent highs; no fresh intervention chatter; US yields easing slightly.

## Equities tape
SPX 7,176 close Nov 19 (-2.02%, ~-8% from recent peak), QQQ/NDX similar, IWM ~264 (-2.2%). Breadth weak (proxy: equal-weight lagged). VIX 28.4 (elevated, highest since March).

## Names / themes only if material overnight
ASTS ~25.55 (near 52w low after sharp decline); TMC ~1.66 (continued slide). No outsized overnight headlines.

## What actually matters this morning
- Monthly OPEX gamma/vol dynamics after multi-day selloff (SPX/VIX).
- Final UMich Sentiment 10:00 ET for consumer/inflation expectations.
- Positioning into Wed GDP/PCE data (rates, USDJPY, index vol).
- TMC mid-Dec NOAA certification window (critical minerals/deep-sea).
- ASTS operational cadence remains undated in 30d window.
